description: Token snapshot and signals: Price, 24h change, liquidity, volume, buys/sells, FDV, pair age, websites and socials for any DEX-traded token (EVM or Solana) from its deepest pool, plus deterministic attention signals (thin or young liquidity, buys-only, extreme moves, no socials) and an attention score. A snapshot with rules, not a grade or a verdict. Source: DexScreener. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: price_usd, liquidity_usd, volume_24h_usd, txns_24h, best_pair, attention_score, signals[].
